messages:
Sophie: FYI prod ap-southeast-2 GPU pool failing to join after last night's firewall sweep. Several nodes stuck at 'keystore decrypt failed' during onboarding. Logs:

```
2026-03-22T03:12:45Z error keystore: decrypt failed status=AccessDenied keyId=arn:aws:kms:ap-southeast-2:... msg="DecryptDeniedByPolicy"
```

Anyone seen this before?

Jared: that's when we rolled fw-rule fw-2026-03-21-73 -> it blocked outbound 443 to internet for private subnets. I added it to tighten egress to audit-sink.

Priya: we intended to block wide egress butKeystore uses external keystore endpoint (not privatelink) for now. We should have whitelisted keystore IPs — my bad, missed that. :sweat_smile:

Rafi: node join flow needs KMS decrypt to unseal disk creds. Without it nodes fail fast and sit in Pending. Can we temporarily open egress for the keystore endpoints to restore capacity?

Emma: alternative is to route keystore traffic over privatelink, but that takes a day to provision DNS + endpoints and will cost ~+$1200/mo per AZ (est). Revert or exception is faster.

Sophie: short-term fix request: add SG allow egress 443 to keystore fqdn/ip-range for ap-southeast-2. Long-term: move keystore to privatelink + update onboarding to fallback to cached preflight keys.

Jared: I can add an exception for keystore IP ranges for 1h. Which IPs do we need? Priya?

Priya: keystore hostnames: keystore.service.redwood-inference.internal (resolves to 52.65.123.9 and 52.65.123.10 in ap-southeast-2) — verified in DNS. Also audit-shipper.sink.redwood (we shouldn't open all of 52.65/16). I'll DM ops a minimal list. :lock:

ops-bot: INCIDENT created: INC-2026-031-0457 by Sophie — severity: P2 — resource: ap-southeast-2 GPU onboarding failures.

Rafi: note — if we open egress to those IPs we'll incur cross-AZ egress when nodes talk to keystore in another AZ; estimate ~2TB/day during warmups => ~$300/day if routed via NATGW. Suggest adding route to privatelink in the same AZ to avoid NAT egress.

Emma: for now, let's do 1) Jared adds SG exception for keystore IPs 2) increase warmup throttle to 5 nodes/min to reduce NATQPS and egress spike 3) Priya to sign off on exception and follow up with privatelink plan.

Jared: making the change now, will post when done.

~2m later~

Jared: Done. SG updated (rule id sg-exc-672). Nodes are re-joining, warmup queue draining. :thumbsup:

Sophie: Confirmed, pool back to 85% capacity (was 18%). Running healthchecks.

Priya: I'll schedule privatelink provisioning ticket and a postmortem on the firewall rollout checklist so this doesn't repeat. Assigning to eng-platform.

Emma: create a short runbook note: if keystore decrypt fails during onboarding check fw-rule-fw-2026-03-21-73 and SG exceptions first. I'll draft it.

Sophie: Thanks all. Leaving incident open until full warmup completes. :eyes:
